calculate_design_effect: calculate Kish's design effect to measure variance increase from weighted survey samples
compute_nonparametric_skew: compute the nonparametric skew of survey weights using mean median and standard deviation
find_prop_above_below: find the proportion of normalized weights above and below specified threshold values
calculate_weighted_median_breakdown: calculate the minimal percent of users containing at least 50 percent of total weights
validate_weights: validate that survey weights are numeric non-negative and optionally contain at least one positive value
